assertions.observation: Projecting masonry bay ends continue through three storeys, with rounded front ends and coping following them.

Four shared inner dividers have broad flat projecting faces and rounded returns at both window edges, with no paired-column groove. Aperture clearance follows 2.70m half-frame offset; full-height assembly and roof coping remain source-guided. Width/projection are approximate.
